# Renew test certificate fixtures through their checked-in specification family

The checked test-certificate instructions pair foo.cert.certspec with generated foo.cert and foo.key, require all three in version control and register .cert/.key in mailnews/moz.build. Renewal changes the validity line before regenerating artifacts. The accepted renewed specifications use 20250101-20300401. Recommend preserving the paired filenames and generation instructions for this fixture family; binary keys were not decoded or used. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/test/certs.
